scope: Technical layout/navigation inspection of the ten original fixture PNGs; no artistic AAA/canonical fidelity or physical hardware certification. Native Next is a separate pending recipe.

390×844 : trois anciens exercices explicites, titre et fermeture persistants, texte complet et retour Escape.
